summary: The team is juggling a critical email infrastructure fix with the ramp-up of Asia Star and Intelligent China marketing, while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and tackling a surge of September content and partnership tasks.
summaryDetail: Right now, the most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout affecting the whole team—everyone must delete and re-login on all devices, update phones, and confirm the backend lock is cleared with JSB to prevent further disruption. In parallel, the global marketing strategy is pivoting to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO and campaigns, with US partnerships on hold; key next steps include Joseph’s focus-area draft, participant profile analysis, and conversion tracking setup. The knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the current design stays but will incorporate Joseph’s ideas for more articles and featured indices, and Joker will implement changes after a quick feedback huddle. Looking ahead, a wave of September deadlines looms—newsletter reviews, republishing Ed Tse’s article, GEO agency feedback on the Custom Program page, and connecting with Brazilian and Berkeley contacts—so the team must balance immediate IT recovery with these strategic content and partnership pushes.
